SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
Special Branch S. 2. Station X
Date January 3, 1933.
File No.
B. REGISTER

Subject (in full) First report on L.V. Skvirsky, suspected Soviet agent.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [Signature]

Information has been received that Leonid Vladimirovitch
Skvirsky is a suspected Soviet agent. He is a Russian Jew
about 28 years of age, married. Skvirsky arrived in Shanghai
from Harbin about 3 months ago and opened a Photographic Studio
at Room 413 Hamilton House, Foochow Road, where he resides.
It is reported that he was formerly employed with the Soviet
Aviation Corps in Moscow and later with the "Gosizdat"
(Government Publishing Trust) in this city. Skvirsky's
sister is the widow of the late well known communist M. M.
Lashevitch, who previous to his death was Commander-in-
chief of the Far Eastern (Russian) Army, and also Harbin
manager of the Chinese Eastern Railway. Mrs. Lashevitch
resides in Moscow. Skvirsky's parents are residing in
Harbin. A few days ago Skvirsky closed his Photographic
Studio and joined the Sanzetti Studio, 73 Nanking Road.

* S.O. 8619

[Signature]
D. S.
Officer i/c Special Branch.

[Signature]

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
特务科 S. 2. X 巡捕房
日期：1933年1月3日。
档案编号
B. 登记册

主题（全称） 关于疑似苏联特工 L.V. Skvirsky 的首份报告。

制作人：D.S. Tcheremshansky。呈报人：[签名]

接获情报称，Leonid Vladimirovitch Skvirsky 为疑似苏联特工。其为俄罗斯犹太人，约28岁，已婚。Skvirsky 于约3个月前从哈尔滨抵达上海，并在福州路汉密尔顿大厦（Hamilton House）413室开设了一家照相馆，其本人亦居住于此。据报，他此前曾在莫斯科的苏联航空队任职，后在本市“国家出版托拉斯”（Gosizdat）工作。Skvirsky 的妹妹是已故著名共产党人 M. M. Lashevitch 的遗孀；Lashevitch 生前曾任远东（俄罗斯）军总司令，并兼任中东铁路哈尔滨管理局局长。Lashevitch 夫人现居莫斯科。Skvirsky 的父母居住在哈尔滨。数日前，Skvirsky 关闭了其照相馆，并加入南京路73号的 Sanzetti 照相馆。

* S.O. 8619

[签名]
D. S.
特务科主管警官。

[签名]

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 4376
C.S.6, Special Branch Form
REPORT
Date February 9, 1937.
Subject L.V. SKVIRSKY --- Return to Shanghai --- Passport Particulars.
Made by D.S. Larby. Forwarded by (签名)

On the 7.2.37, Leonid Vladimirovitch SKVIRSKY, a
suspected Soviet agent, accompanied by his wife returned to
Shanghai from India per the S/S, "Carthage".
The following particulars were supplied the Chinese
Passport Authorities on the aforementioned person's arrival
at Shanghai :
Nationality - Lithuanian
Age - 35 years
Place of birth - Vilna
Profession - Artist photographer, at
Skvirsky Studio, 153, Nanking Road
Passport Details - No. 348, issued on
28.10.31 at Harbin.
Length of stay in China - Indefinite.
In addition to the above, the following particulars
regarding Mrs. SKVIRSKY were given :
Name - Lulah Thompson SKVIRSKY
Age - 26 years
Nationality - American
Place of birth - Atalanta, Georgia
Passport details - No. 4238, U.S.A.,
issued on 30.1.34 at San Francisco.

(印：SPECIAL BRANCH SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE - 9 FEB 1937)

D.S. Shabaroff
I.B.
Noted & entered
on the card.
(签名)
D. C. (Special Branch).

K.G. Larby.
D. S.

C.S.6，特务科表格
报告
日期：1937年2月9日。
主题：L.V. SKVIRSKY --- 返回上海 --- 护照详情。
制作人：D.S. Larby。呈报人：(签名)

1937年2月7日，疑似苏联特工 Leonid Vladimirovitch SKVIRSKY 在其妻子陪同下，乘坐“迦太基”号轮船（S/S "Carthage"）从印度返回上海。
在上述人员抵达上海时，向中方护照管理机构提供了以下详情：
国籍 - 立陶宛
年龄 - 35岁
出生地 - 维尔纳（Vilna）
职业 - 艺术摄影师，任职于
南京路153号 Skvirsky 照相馆
护照详情 - 第348号，
1931年10月28日签发于哈尔滨。
在华停留期限 - 无限期。
除上述内容外，还提供了关于 SKVIRSKY 夫人的以下详情：
姓名 - Lulah Thompson SKVIRSKY
年龄 - 26岁
国籍 - 美国
出生地 - 佐治亚州亚特兰大（Atalanta, Georgia）
护照详情 - 美国第4238号，
1934年1月30日签发于旧金山。

(印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特务科 - 1937年2月9日)

D.S. Shabaroff
情报局（I.B.）
已注记并录入
卡片。
(签名)
D. C. (特务科)。

K.G. Larby.
D. S.
